name: cv-builder-private
description: Securely read, tailor, export, and manage CVs in one private CV Builder deployment.

interface.shortDescription: Manage CVs in your private deployment.
interface.longDescription: List and read saved CVs, create or update tailored versions with confirmation, export PDFs, and delete CVs only after explicit approval. OAuth access is isolated to one deployment owner.
defaultPrompt: List my saved CVs and summarize their target roles.
Create a tailored CV after showing me the planned changes.
Export my selected CV as a PDF.
